title: Sweep
description: A single execution of a sweep transfer triggered by a sweep configuration.

sweepID.description: Unique identifier for this sweep execution.

sweepConfigID.description: The sweep configuration that triggered this sweep.

walletID.description: The wallet from which funds were swept.

transferID.description: The transfer created to move the swept funds.

createdOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the sweep was created.
